summary: Two climbers stuck at Castle Rock (29,400 Boulder Canyon Drive) after their ropes tangled on descent; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Nederland Fire Department, Boulder Emergency Services and the Boulder County Sheriff's Office performed a tactical rescue; both climbers were assisted down safely, uninjured.
notes: BCSO release dated May 20, 2020; incident May 19, 2020 about 9:40 p.m. Inserted run 1015 (Boulder Weekly chunk).
